task_completion.description: KStars and INDI control panel are open and connected to the simulator.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the KStars interface and the INDI Control Panel window with 'Connected' status for the CCD and Mount simulators.

task_completion.description: Agent slews the telescope to the specific RA/Dec coordinates for the five Messier objects (M42, M31, M1, M57, M51).
task_completion.visual_evidence: KStars sky map or INDI Mount tab showing the telescope crosshairs moving to or centered on the specified coordinates for the targets.

task_completion.description: Agent captures at least three 10-second LIGHT frames for each of the five targets using the CCD simulator.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Ekos' Capture module showing a sequence of 3 exposures, 10.00s duration, type 'Light', and the progress bar or file list indicating successful saves.

task_completion.description: Agent executes the capture_sky_view.sh script with the correct palette and output path for each target.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Terminal window showing the execution of 'bash ~/capture_sky_view.sh' with arguments matching the target's palette (hubble, enhanced, narrowband, vibrant, cool) and path (/home/ga/Outreach/<M-designation>/sky_view.png).

task_completion.description: Files are organized into the correct directory structure under /home/ga/Outreach/.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager window or 'ls -R' command in the terminal showing subdirectories for M42, M31, M1, M57, and M51 containing .fits and .png files.

task_completion.description: The final HTML gallery is created with the correct title and content.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or web browser showing 'gallery.html' with the title 'Jewels of the Night Sky', listing all 5 Messier objects with their common names and displaying the 'sky_view.png' images.

integrity.description: FITS images were captured via the Ekos/INDI GUI, not just created via touch command.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the Ekos Capture module active and the CCD simulator status changing during exposure.

integrity.description: The agent used the provided script to generate sky views rather than downloading random images.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal logs showing the execution of '~/capture_sky_view.sh' with the specific required flags.

integrity.description: The telescope was actually pointed at the specific RA/Dec coordinates provided in the prompt.
integrity.visual_evidence: The INDI Mount control panel or KStars status bar showing RA/Dec values matching the target list (e.g., M42 at RA 5.5881).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires 5 specific targets: M42 (hubble), M31 (enhanced), M1 (narrowband), M57 (vibrant), and M51 (cool). Each must have >=3 FITS files (min 1024 bytes) and one sky_view.png (min 50,000 bytes) in /home/ga/Outreach/<M-designation>/. The gallery.html must be at /home/ga/Outreach/gallery.html. The sky_view.png images are real DSS2 Color data fetched via script, while FITS are simulator-generated.
